name: every-kind
description: Every kind of value, written loosely and printed in the builder's form; what the builder cannot draw stays as code
template:
{
    "@type": "Thing",
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "name": "{{ product.name }}",
    "description": "{{product.short_description|plain|limit:300|default:\"Made by \\\"Linden\\\"\"}}",
    "postalCode": "01069",
    "count": 12,
    "ratio": 4.50,
    "isAccessibleForFree": true,
    "itemCondition": "https://schema.org/NewCondition",
    "braces": "Write {{{{ and }} as they are",
    "headline": "{{product.name}} by {{store.name}}",
    "comparison": "{{ product.final_price > 10 }}",
    "brand": {"name": "{{product.manufacturer | default:'O\\'Neill'}}", "@type": "Brand"},
    "loose": {"name": "Linden"},
    "both": {"@type": ["Product", "Car"], "name": "{{product.name}}"},
    "policy": {"@include": "return-policy", "@if": "product.on_sale"},
    "image": {"@each": "product.gallery", "@as": "picture", "@limit": 2, "@value": "{{picture.url}}"},
    "guarded": {"@if": "reviews.count", "@value": {"@each": "reviews.latest", "@value": "{{review.text}}"}},
    "price": {"@value": "{{product.final_price}}", "@if": "product.on_sale"},
    "tags": ["Leather", "{{product.sku}}", {"@if": "product.on_sale", "@value": "Sale"}],
    "filtered": {"@each": "reviews.latest", "@if": "review.rating", "@value": "{{review.text}}"},
    "complex": {"@if": "product.on_sale and reviews.count", "@type": "Offer"},
    "empty": {},
    "nothing": null
}
